newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cubiertas says merger to boost earnings.
newsitem.headline: Cubiertas says merger to boost earnings.

text.p: Spanish construction firm Cubiertas y MZOV planned merger with the Entrecanales group will increase both earnings per share and value medium term, Cubiertas said in a note issued from London on Thursday.
"The merger will be a combination of two complementary businesses expected to lead to strong earnings and value enhancement in the medium term," the firm said.
Cubiertas will issue 6,065,100 new ordinary shares in exchange for EUR S.A., the holding for the Entrecanales group, and Entrecanales y Tavora S.A., the building subsidiary.
The shares to be issued are based on a valuation of Cubiertas and Entrecanales in the proportion of 1 to 1.16, the firm said.
The new Cubiertas shares will represent 53.7 percent of the enlarged share capital to be distributed to shareholders of EUR S.A.
